global: This shio broth ramen features a clear, golden-yellow, glossy soup with thin noodles and green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl with a glossy rim, it includes dark green nori, golden-brown chashu pork, pale yellow menma, and a pale pink naruto fish cake. Set on a wooden table with warm brown grain and glossy reflections.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and glossy reflections from ambient light.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-yellow, and glossy, with thin noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a slightly glossy, textured surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with golden-brown, slightly crispy edges and tender, pale interior.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft texture and faint green specks on their surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale pink swirl center, creamy white base, slightly textured surface.
